An indigenous perspective on #artificialintelligence, from the 
Kággaba (also known as the Kogui) in Colombia: 

"You are here asking yourselves how you can align artificial intelligence with human values.

We see that you are frightened of what may come of all this.

So we ask a question we believe is more fundamental than yours: what other values could artificial intelligence really have?

You are the only example it has.

What did you expect?"

https://openwisdom.substack.com/p/an-urgent-message-on-artificial-intelligence

#ai #humanvalues
